verdict.rationale: Veo is a cloud-hosted video generation model offered through an API and Google apps, so letting users choose where their data is stored is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data residency controls. Country availability complaints about VideoFX concern access, not where data is stored, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
